v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Benígne fac, Dómine, * in bona voluntáte tua Sion.
text.en: In thy good will, O Lord, * deal favourably with Sion.

text.la: Rectus Dóminus, * Deus noster, et non est iníquitas in eo.
text.en: The Lord our God is righteous * and there is no iniquity in him.

text.la: A timóre inimíci * éripe, Dómine, ánimam meam.
text.en: Deliver my soul, * O Lord, from the fear of the enemy.

text.la: In servis suis * miserébitur Dóminus et propítius erit terræ pópuli sui.
text.en: The Lord will judge * his servants, and will have mercy on the people of his land.

text.la: Laudáte * Dóminum secúndum multitúdinem magnitúdinis eius.
text.en: Praise ye the Lord * according to the excellence of his greatness.

text.la: Clama, ne cesses, quasi tuba exálta vocem tuam, et annúntia pópulo meo scélera eórum, et dómui Iacob peccáta eórum.
text.en: Cry, cease not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and show my people their wicked doings, and the house of Jacob their sins.

v.la: Ángelis suis Deus mandávit de te.
v.en: God hath given His Angels charge over thee.

r.la: Ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.
r.en: To keep thee in all thy ways.

text.la: Inclinávit se Iesus, * et scribébat in terra: Si quis sine peccáto est, mittat in eam lápidem.
text.en: Jesus stooped down, * and wrote on the ground: He that is without sin, let him cast a stone at her.

text.la: Præsta, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut, qui se, affligéndo carnem, ab aliméntis ábstinent; sectándo iustítiam a culpa ieiúnent.
text.en: O Almighty God, grant, we beseech thee, that as many as, to afflict the body, do abstain from meats, may, by following after righteousness, fast from sin.

text.la: Istárum est enim regnum cælórum, quæ contempsérunt vitam mundi, et pervenérunt ad prǽmia regni, et lavérunt stolas suas in sánguine Agni.
text.en: For theirs is the Kingdom of heaven who love not their lives in this world, and have attained unto the reward of the Kingdom, and have washed their robes in the blood of the Lamb.

v.la: Glória et honóre coronásti eas, Dómine.
v.en: Thou hast crowned them with glory and honour, O Lord.

r.la: Et constituísti eas super ópera mánuum tuárum.
r.en: And madest them to have dominion over the works of thy hands.

text.la: Da nobis, quǽsumus, Dómine Deus noster, sanctárum Mártyrum tuárum Perpétuæ et Felicitátis palmas incessábili devotióne venerári: ut quas digna mente non póssumus celebráre, humílibus saltem frequentémus obséquiis.
text.en: Grant unto us, we beseech thee, O Lord, our God, that we may ever call to mind, with all worship and thanksgiving, the victory of thy holy Martyrs Perpetua and Felicitas, and although we know that our mind cannot comprehend thee who art this day their exceeding great reward, give us always the grace humbly to worship thee.
